# Leak Detection Bargersville

> Non-invasive water leak detection for homes in Bargersville, Indiana and across Johnson County. We confirm a leak, isolate the line, pinpoint it with pressure testing, acoustic listening and thermal imaging, mark the exact spot, and document it with photos for the plumber and insurer.

- Location: Bargersville, IN 46106 (service-area business)
- Service area: Bargersville, Greenwood, Franklin, Center Grove, Whiteland & New Whiteland, Trafalgar — https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/service-area/

## Services
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/slab-leak-detection/): leaks in water lines under concrete foundations
- [Underground Water Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/underground-water-leak-detection/): leaks in the buried service line between the meter and the house
- [Hidden Water Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/hidden-water-leak-detection/): leaks inside walls, floors, showers and ceilings
- [Pool & Spa Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/pool-spa-leak-detection/): shell, fittings and plumbing lines
- [Thermal Imaging Inspection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/thermal-imaging-inspection/): infrared moisture inspection with photo report
- [Irrigation Leak Detection](https://www.leakdetectionbargersville.com/services/irrigation-leak-detection/): sprinkler mainlines, zones, heads and valves
